Pool incident note
Written by Hamid Rahimi, duty lifeguard, Friday 20 February 2026

Last night (Thursday 19 February), at about 19:35, a woman cut her foot on a chipped tile at the shallow-end edge, beside lane 3. I cleaned the cut and put a plaster on it. She said it was fine and carried on swimming, then left by the side door before I could take her name.

I taped off the tile and told Neil in the office. The tile needs replacing.
